summary_1line: Rama sends Bharata and his sons Taksha and Pushkala to conquer the Gandharvas’ cities, leading to a fierce seven‑day battle after their armies meet.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata marches from Ayodhya with his vast army and two young princes while lions, tigers, boars, and ominous spirits follow the host.
The armies of Bharata and Yudhajita assemble before the city of the Gandharvas as the defenders gather shouting for battle.
A chaotic battlefield rages for days as warriors clash amid dust and weapons in a brutal stalemate between humans and Gandharvas.
